title: Looking for a free asset pack that contains enemies that can be found in Heian Japan

posts.author: MythrilKnight
posts.body: I need an asses pack that contains enemies that would make sense to appear in Heian Japan. It also needs to be free so that I can use it since I'm a broke ass college student right now and I can't find work anywhere to just get it myself. Any links would be helpful

posts.author: EntangledPear
posts.body: Can you be more specific about what enemies you mean? Also, what RPG Makers do you own? There might be some battlers for the older versions, and if you own those, you could use them.
